metadata.name: Schema Drift Impact Analyzer Ground Truth
metadata.purpose: Independent expected impact labels for the 10 seeded schema changes
metadata.analysis_rule: Each seeded change is analyzed independently against the before state

evidence: CRM schema explicitly declares email as string
After schema renames email to email_address
Ingestion uses PERMISSIVE mode
nb02_silver_customers selects and transforms email
changes.validation_required: Confirm the explicit CRM schema and behavior when email is renamed to email_address

evidence: CRM schema explicitly declares region_code as string
After schema renames region_code to region
Ingestion uses PERMISSIVE mode
nb02_silver_customers selects region_code
nb06_gold_customer joins using region_code
Power BI visuals use the resulting region_name
changes.validation_required: Confirm the explicit CRM schema and whether missing region_code becomes null or causes ingestion failure

evidence: ERP orders ingestion query explicitly selects discount_amount
nb03_silver_orders selects discount_amount
nb05_gold_sales uses discount_amount in net_amount calculation
changes.validation_required: Confirm the SQL source rejects the missing projected column

evidence: ERP orders ingestion query explicitly selects ship_date
The source column is removed in the after schema
changes.validation_required: Confirm source query failure when ship_date no longer exists

evidence: ERP order lines ingestion query explicitly selects unit_price
nb04_silver_order_lines uses quantity and unit_price to derive line_amount
Downstream sales transformations depend on line_amount
changes.validation_required: Confirm the Spark expression cannot safely perform the existing numeric calculation with the new string type

evidence: Product ingestion uses SELECT *
Product ingestion enables overwrite_schema
No existing downstream consumer of brand was identified
changes.validation_required: Confirm no pipeline, notebook, semantic model or visual references brand

evidence: CRM schema does not declare loyalty_tier
Ingestion uses an explicit schema
No existing downstream consumer of loyalty_tier was identified
changes.validation_required: Confirm whether the explicit CRM schema ignores the added field without failing ingestion

evidence: Decimal precision increases from 18 to 20
Decimal scale increases from 2 to 4
The change preserves the existing numeric representation and expands capacity
changes.validation_required: Confirm downstream expressions and target table types accept the widened decimal

evidence: Product ingestion uses SELECT * and overwrite_schema
nb05_gold_sales references cost_price
cost_amount is derived using cost_price and quantity
changes.validation_required: Confirm the renamed source column is propagated to Bronze and the existing Gold transformation fails

evidence: CRM schema explicitly declares is_active as boolean
After schema changes is_active to string with Y/N values
Ingestion uses PERMISSIVE mode
Gold customer dimension carries is_active
Active Customers measure depends on dim_customer[is_active]
changes.validation_required: Confirm how Y/N values are handled by the configured CRM reader and the Power BI measure
